newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Las Vegas, Nev.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Las Vegas, Nev.

text.p: PUBLIC NOTICE is hereby given that sealed bids will be received by the City Treasurer's Office of the City of Las Vegas, Nevada at the 400 East Stewart Avenue, 6th Floor, Las Vegas, Nevada on
until 8:00 a.m. Las Vegas time for the purchase of

$10,500,000 principal amount of its Las Vegas, Nevada, General Obligation (Limited Tax) Medium-Term Recreation Bonds, Series February 1, 1997 (the Bonds''). Bids may also be submitted using the PARITY bidding system.

Regardless of the bidding method used, each bid must be for all the Bonds. The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 and will mature serially on February 1 in the years 1998 through 2007, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale. The bidder may offer to purchase the Bonds at a discount not to exceed $157,500. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase all of the Bonds at the lowest interest cost, calculated in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a cashier's check or surety bond in the amount of $105,000 payable to the City of Las Vegas, Nevada or naming it as the beneficiary, in the case of a surety bond. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Official Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the City's financial

advisors:Public Financial Management, Inc. at 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111 (415) 982-5544 or Hobbs, Ong & Associates, Inc. at 3900 Paradise Road, Suite 152, Las Vegas, Nevada 89109 (702) 733-7223. Dated:January 30, 1997
